positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
National public benefit corporation modernizing government platforms. Working on modernizing USDA’s WIC Management Information System program.
- Built scripts and tools for streamlining creation of datasets for research and development team
- Analyzed capabilities of multiple state systems through desk research and vendor interviews

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Non-profit organization building research-backed tools to support education. Worked on the core platform and front-end infrastructure for Summit Learning Platform and Along.org using React and Ruby.
- Developed new multimedia recorder for Along 2.0 using Typescript and React hooks to enable online student-teacher interaction
- Integrated Learnosity APIs including real time testing, analytics, and assessment control for the classroom environment
- Led team pushes to improve older areas, updating deprecated and untyped code, and ensuring WCAG compliance
- Optimized mentorship and curriculum surface areas, reducing page load times by 30%
- Significantly increased front-end test coverage from 10% to ~80%, leading to a reduction in incidents by 90%
- Exceeded expectations in performance reviews for two consecutive years
- Mentored junior developers on front-end and general career development, improving performance review results by one level

positions.title: Assistant Instructor
positions.description:
Summer boot camp teaching students how to develop full web applications. Provided individualized instruction to students on web development, product development, and management principles.
- Mentored and guided 149 students on development of full web applications
- Facilitated release of approximately 100 web ready applications from concept to execution

projects.title: Along
projects.description:
Award winning free online platform built to deepen connections between teachers and students.

- Main developer for Along 2.0’s audio/video composer rebuild and upgrade, improving reusability, functionality, and ease-of-use.
- Given multiple shoutouts for being a major contributor to optional visual upgrades, bug fixes, and general performance.

projects.title: Summit Learning Platform
projects.description:
Free online learning platform used by 350+ schools, 75k+ students. My team focused on differentiated learning and curriculum.

- Acted as the main developer for integrating curriculum testing/analytics API, critical mutation rewrites, and other end-to-end features.
- Led major push to improve test coverage of team surface area to near 100% and reducing incidents frequency to ~10%.
- Received 2 years worth of “exceeds expectations” reviews.

https://www.summitlearning.org/
